name: Glaucoma Today house style (AMA-like), checked against Sept/Oct 2026 Feature reference list
notes: Copied from ama.json and checked against the 24-entry list in Johnson et al, Glaucoma Today Sept/Oct 2026 pp 41-45 and the 5-entry list in Berdahl, same issue. Observed: numbered by first appearance; all authors listed up to 6, first 3 + 'et al' when 7 or more (e.g. 'Zhao J, Solano MM, Oldenburg CE, et al.'); initials without periods; sentence-case article titles; NLM journal abbreviations; 'Year;vol(issue):pages' with full (uncondensed) page ranges, issue omitted in some entries; DOI printed as 'doi:10.xxxx' with no URL and no trailing period; superscript in-text numbers. NOT observed in the issue: any web page entry or 'Accessed' wording, so the AMA 'Accessed {date}.' wording is kept as an unverified default. Italic journal names could not be confirmed from the PDF text layer (an italic font is embedded); kept on.
